name: LaTeX (TeX Live)
description: Installs TeX Live from a pinned tlnet-final snapshot (selectable scheme) and puts the binaries on PATH.

version.description: TeX Live release year to install, from that year's tlnet-final snapshot via install-tl.

scheme.description: TeX Live scheme to install, from scheme-basic (minimal) to scheme-full (complete distribution).

stateDir.description: If set, installs TeX Live to this path at container create and reuses it on rebuilds (persist it by mounting a volume there). Empty installs into the image at build time.
